name: Speedy Egg Fried Rice
description: The best use for leftover rice. Cold, day-old rice fries up into separate, slightly crisp grains.
recipeIngredient: 4 spring onions, sliced, whites and greens separated
350 g cooked and cooled long-grain rice

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oil in a wok until very hot. Stir-fry the spring onion whites and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and peas and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes, breaking up any clumps, until piping hot.
Push the rice to one side, pour the eggs into the gap and scramble, then mix through the rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with the spring onion greens.
